scope: two-stage folds-3/4 cross-fit of spectral-temporal extended Prithvi pretraining plus a zero-initialized protected scene residual

data_contract.endpoint_rule: each held fold uses only the opposite fold for both extended pretraining and supervised fitting
data_contract.pretraining_sources: 50/50 request-balanced opposite-fold MARS imagery and fixed MARS-disjoint MethaneS2CM auxiliary imagery
data_contract.pretraining_labels: no scene labels, masks, or plume assets are opened by either unlabeled dataset
data_contract.mars_physical_scale: producer uint16 divided by 10000 exactly; corrects the earlier Prithvi path's factor-of-two scale
data_contract.model_frames: reference then target, six bands, resized to 128x128
data_contract.location_policy: constant zero sentinel for every row; geographic coordinates never become model features
data_contract.temporal_policy: real MARS acquisition dates; fixed relative-date proxies for MethaneS2CM T-90/T-365

pretraining.trainable_encoder_contract: all-block attention LoRA plus full patch embedder plus final transformer block
pretraining.trainable_decoder_contract: first two pretrained MAE decoder blocks plus decoder norm/prediction layers; discarded after adaptation
pretraining.loss: MAESTRO-inspired patch-group-normalized masked L1 plus 0.2 temporal-difference L1

scene_training.architecture: reference/target/signed-difference/absolute-difference patch fusion, attentive/mean/top-k pooling, sensor embedding, bounded residual around frozen champion
scene_training.sampler: inverse site count times square-root class/sensor balance times 1+2*absolute champion error
scene_training.initialization: final residual layer exactly zero, reproducing the frozen champion before fitting

search.selection_rule: pilot gates, then worst-fold AP delta, pooled AP delta, matched-FPR recall, smaller correction strength
search.replication_rule: the selected pilot strength is frozen; no search is repeated under seed two

research_basis.name: ExPLoRA
research_basis.role: parameter-efficient unsupervised extended pretraining under domain shift

research_basis.name: MAESTRO
research_basis.role: patch-group-wise spectral target normalization for multitemporal EO MAE

invariants: Draft status permits only a two-step/tiny-row finite-gradient smoke and no metric report.
MARS folds 0/1/2 and the official test are neither loaded nor named as input paths.
A held fold never contributes pixels, labels, masks, statistics, or gradients to its endpoint model.
The pilot seed must pass before seed two runs; seed two cannot change strength or hyperparameters.
Failure writes no deployable artifact or promoted score cache.
Bulk checkpoints, artifacts, and score caches remain Git-ignored; only compact code, protocol, tests, and reports are tracked.
